scope: Read-only reanalysis of frozen Navier-Stokes evidence; no new CFD, GPU or performance run by this authoring task. New independent operator correctness artifact is maintained separately by the operator author.
interpretation_constraints: Two reference refinements are not independent continuum certificates or independent CFD implementations.
The 78 trajectories represent 39 configurations across two numerically identical cache policies, not 78 independent feature draws.
RFM35 seed8353 retains rank39; four others rank38. Accuracy differences confound seed and rank.
FD fourth order denotes radial spatial differencing; time is second-order SBDF2.
Local FFT and warp ratios must not be used as complete-solver speedups.
Final 160-slot timing campaign was not accepted; no final ranking or confidence intervals are estimated from its partial runs.
First-use/cache-hit policies do not clear driver/OS caches.
All newly expanded statistics are computed from archived records, separate from any new independent operator correctness example.
